name: web-dark-purple-glow-fintech-landing-showcase
title: Dark Violet Savings App Landing Page
whatItIs: Two long landing-page screens on a lavender gradient backdrop: near-black pages with a large sans headline where 'growing' is circled in violet, a floating savings-chart card cluster, feature cards, steps, testimonials and three-tier pricing with the middle plan highlighted.
whatItMeans: Black plus a single soft violet feels premium and calm, matching the 'quietly growing' promise. The hand-drawn circle adds humanity to a very polished page.
techniques: Hand-drawn oval around one headline word
Floating overlapping cards in the hero showing key numbers
Highlighted middle pricing tier with a glow and 'Most popular' tag
Micro uppercase eyebrow labels above each section title
Presenting the design on a soft gradient backdrop to lift it

vocabulary.definition: A loose ellipse drawn around one word to emphasize it.
A small label above a heading that names the section.
A pricing plan visually elevated to steer choice.
